# spo_theme (Data Source)

Look up an existing Theme object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `is_inverted` (Boolean) Whether the theme is a dark (inverted) theme.
- `theme_json` (String) The theme palette as a JSON string (e.g. {"palette":{"themePrimary":"#0078d4"}}).
